purpose: Move the accessibility-first potential-flow hypotheses from public-research truth to direct actor-side truth without pitching a product or pre-pairing actors.

outreach_events.recipient: Xuzhou Institute of Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship College
public_evidence: 2026 Xuzhou 'Dream+' OPC training camp had 40 selected participants and a public training contact
the college publicly lists the email used for this outreach
outreach_events.request_shape: request staff to forward an anonymous/non-sales validation invitation to relevant OPC participants
questions: most recent case where product/technology was basically ready but commercial progress stalled
exact blockage: customer discovery, wrong decision maker, industry language, trust, pricing, decision chain, negotiation or other
what current incubator/mentor/community/business-matching route did and did not solve
whether one bounded senior-industry contribution would materially change the outcome
what result would be valuable enough for a real paid or reciprocal commitment rather than generic advice

outreach_events.recipient: China University of Mining and Technology Retirement Affairs Office
public_evidence: the office publicly serves CUMT retired faculty/staff and publishes a general contact mailbox
the office operates retiree activity, party-branch and next-generation-support structures
outreach_events.request_shape: request staff to forward a non-sales anonymous validation invitation to interested retired faculty/professionals
questions: which valuable professional resources became materially underused after retirement
how existing reemployment, volunteering, advisory or lecture routes fit or fail
whether one-off bounded customer/industry/solution judgment is easier to accept than long-term consulting
what activities are acceptable versus explicitly refused and what time boundary is acceptable
what compensation or reciprocal outcome would be fair rather than unpaid help

next_decisive_truth: at least one direct young-OPC reply describing a recent bounded commercial blockage after existing support
at least one direct senior-transition reply describing a callable resource plus explicit refusal/commitment boundary
repeat evidence across multiple independent actors before any pairing
if access intermediaries decline or ignore outreach, seek alternative ordinary lawful actor channels rather than treating silence as market rejection
